name: EAN-13 Barcode Generator
description: Generate a real, scannable EAN-13 barcode as downloadable SVG from 12 digits (check digit calculated) or 13 digits (check digit verified) — no upload, fully client-side.

faq.question: Is this a real, scannable barcode or just a picture that looks like one?
faq.answer: It's a genuine EAN-13 encoding, built from the actual ISO/IEC 15420 bar-width tables (the same left/right digit patterns and guard bars every real EAN-13 scanner expects) — not a decorative striped image. Downloaded as SVG, it should scan correctly when printed at a reasonable size.

faq.question: What are the 12 vs. 13 digit modes?
faq.answer: A finished EAN-13 code is always 13 digits, but the 13th is always derived from the first 12 via a checksum, never chosen freely. Enter 12 digits to have that check digit calculated for you, or paste a full 13-digit code you already have to verify it's correct — a wrong check digit means the code was mistyped or is invalid.

faq.question: Where do the first 12 digits come from for a real product?
faq.answer: In practice, the country/company prefix and product code are assigned by GS1 (the organization that administers barcode standards) once you register — this tool handles the encoding and checksum math, not the registration/assignment process.
